title: private-deployment-acme-weekly-sync-2026-06-08
content:
Private Deployment - Acme weekly sync notes (prep + follow-up)
Date: 2026-06-08
Owner: Avery Chen (notes)
Attendees: Avery, Luis, Maya, Samir, Tessa, (ACME) - Raj, Priya

Purpose:
- Weekly sync to track VPC/on-prem rollout milestones, unresolved blockers, and owners for next steps. Keep this doc as the single source for next actions before handoff to PM.

Agenda (planned):
1) Quick status round (2-3 min each)
2) Network/VPC peering + connectivity testing
3) On-prem infra readiness (racks, power, switch config)
4) Security: certs, KMS integration, audit/logging
5) Performance test plan + schedule (load windows)
6) Blockers & owners, action items, next meeting cadence

Notes from sync / updates:
- Status round:
  - ACME: still on track for initial cutover week (2026-06-22) but flagged a possible datacenter maintenance window; Raj to confirm by EOD 6/9.
  - Networking (Luis): VPC peering established between Redwood cloud control plane and ACME's VPC in us-west-2. Ran connectivity smoke tests — control plane -> agent reached on 1/1 tests, but agent->control-plane 3/10 failed (timeout). Likely related to SNAT/NAT gateway rules.
  - On-prem (Maya): Rack power scheduled for 6/14; delivery of edge switches delayed (ETA 6/13). We need final switch configs to validate VLANs.
  - Security (Samir): KMS integration pending; ACME requests HSM-backed keys for production — legal procurement in flight. Cert rotation automation needs one more env var change (PR-87).
  - SRE: Load testing moved to 6/17 slot (pre-cutover); need stable baseline before cutover.

Connectivity blocker details:
- Symptom: agent -> control-plane API calls intermittently time out from ACME prod subnet.
- Hypothesis: NAT gateway ephemeral port exhaustion or incorrect return route for ephemeral ports.
- Immediate checks: ask ACME to provide 2 full traceroutes (before and after NAT) + NAT gateway metrics (port utilization).
- Owner: Luis (follow up)
- Jira: ACME-342 (networking)

On-prem infra readiness:
- Switches arriving 6/13; rack power 6/14. Must coordinate on-site ops window for cable mapping (2 hrs) the morning of 6/15.
- Action: Maya to circulate cable map template + request site contact availability by 6/10.
- Owner: Maya

Security & certs/KMS:
- PR-87 (github) fixes cert rotation env var; blocked until ACME provides KMS access bucket and service-account mapping.
- ACME legal to confirm HSM contract timeline; expect 2-week lead. Need contingency: use soft-KMS in staging and schedule production KMS cutover after week 2.
- Owner: Samir to follow with ACME security and legal.

Performance testing plan:
- Goal: baseline 99th percentile latency < 450ms for 512 token seq at target concurrency.
- Load window: multi-hour run on 6/17, off-peak 02:00-06:00 PDT (ACME requested).
- Need: test dataset, traffic shape, SLO targets, and throttling policy.
- Action: SRE to post test plan doc + k6 scripts in GitHub by 6/12.
- Owner: Tessa (SRE) + SRE team

Open PRs / infra changes:
- github:repo/acme-deploy/PR-87 (cert rotation) — awaiting ACME env values. Owner: Avery to nudge.
- github:repo/acme-deploy/PR-90 (agent backoff tuning) — merged to staging; will promote after load test.

Action items (concrete):
- Luis: request traceroute + NAT metrics from ACME networking team; due 2026-06-09.
- Maya: send cable map template + collect site contact availability; due 2026-06-10.
- Samir: follow up with ACME security/legal re HSM timeline and provide contingency plan for soft-KMS; due 2026-06-11.
- Tessa: finalize perf test plan + publish k6 scripts to GH; due 2026-06-12.
- Avery: ping ACME for env values for PR-87 and escalate if no response by 6/10; due 2026-06-10.
- Raj (ACME): confirm datacenter maintenance window/no-conflict by EOD 6/9.

Risks / unknowns (notes-to-self):
- If switch delivery slips further, we may need to move cutover week; track alternate date slots (6/29 or 7/6) — flag in calendar.
- HSM procurement could slip >2 weeks; ensure rollback to soft-KMS is scripted and tested in staging.
- Network timeouts are highest risk for initial cutover — prioritize NAT/traceroute debugging.

Decisions made:
- Keep cutover target 2026-06-22 for now; escalate to contingency if any two of (switch delivery, rack power, NAT fix) slip past 6/15.
- Proceed with staging perf test 6/17 even if some infra pieces still pending — we still want agent/ctrl-plane path validated.

Notes for next sync (prep list):
- Status on traceroutes and NAT metrics (Luis)
- Site contact/cable mapping confirmed (Maya)
- HSM/soft-KMS decision update (Samir)
- Perf test artifacts uploaded and schedule confirmation (Tessa)
- PR-87 env values confirmed (Avery)

Meeting cadence: keep weekly syncs on Mondays 10:00am PT until cutover complete. Next meeting: 2026-06-15 10:00am PT.

Misc / loose thoughts (scratchpad):
- Consider adding a short runbook snippet for emergency rollback to hosted fallback model if on-prem experiences critical failures during first 48h after cutover. Draft a two-step playbook: 1) route traffic to hosted; 2) invalidate local KV caches gracefully. Owner: Avery draft by 6/12.
- We should confirm logging retention to satisfy ACME compliance (90d vs 365d). Add as low-priority ticket.

End notes: keep this doc as the single canonical weekly notes for ACME; copy into Confluence summary after cutover.

-- Avery
